CustomField.label: Deputy abwesent ab
CustomField.description: SCRUM-457 AC10: Start of the named deputy's OWN open absence (blank when the deputy has none). Written only by AbsenceSyncHandler, mirrored from Absence__c WHERE Absent_User__c = deputy. Mirrored as dates, not as a boolean: a boolean written at save time is wrong the day the deputy's absence ends. Read by the Absence_Ohne_Deputy__c marker.
